{{Quote|We must keep our faith in the Republic. The day we stop believing democracy can work is the day we lose it.|Queen Jamillia|<ref name="AOC" />}}
'''Jamillia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]] as the successor of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] from [[25 BBY/Legends|25]] to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Jamillia, like her predecessor, was a young woman when elected (though not as young as Padmé Amidala was during her first term), with a regal and dignified bearing. Her title was formally styled as '''Her Royal Highness, Queen Jamillia of Naboo'''. She was succeeded as Queen in 21 BBY by Queen [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Jamillia came from the southeastern regions of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="dbJ" /> a peaceful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Jamillia's [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|predecessor]], after serving two successful four-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] terms as [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], was popular enough that many of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] wanted to amend their [[Constitution of Naboo/Legends|constitution]] to allow Amidala to serve a third term. However, she graciously declined the honor, and Jamillia became Naboo's next elected [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]]. The new Queen asked her still-popular predecessor to continue her career in public service by becoming Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], even though Amidala had reached the normal age for the Naboo to retire from [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and was well within her rights to do so. Padmé agreed and became Naboo's representative in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="AOC" />

The membership of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Royal Advisory Council]] under Queen Jamillia was apparently different from the membership under Amidala, with the exception of [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] and [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]].<ref name="AOC" />

[[File:Jamillia.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Queen Jamillia of Naboo]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Jamillia was one of many planetary rulers who opened up their worlds to aid many [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] who were fleeing the planets seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Hnn-Mid Rim Worlds Open Ports to Refugees">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_1.html|Mid Rim Worlds Open Ports to Refugees}}</ref> For this she received much criticism, particularly from unions representing Naboo spice miners, such as the [[Naboo Moon Mining Union]], whose main ports became a part of the refugee movement on Naboo.<ref name="HNN" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after surviving a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-backed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]], Amidala left [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the safety of Naboo. Jamillia was very worried about the Senator and helped conceal her presence.<ref name="AOC" /> Before Amidala left for the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]], Jamillia suggested to her that she make contact with her [[Naberrie family/Legends|family]], who had also grown very concerned for her safety.<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> Just after the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], during the run-up to the [[Battle of Ohma-D'un]], Jamillia appointed Amidala's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], as Naboo's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War">''[[Star Wars: Republic: The New Face of War]]''</ref> Shortly after the war started, she would be replaced by Queen [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valley">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valley]]''</ref>

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Jamillia asked Amidala to mediate a dispute between Naboo's Artisans' Guild and the [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]] Silver Sand Consortium. The Queen also offered refugee status to the people of [[Torbel]], a [[City/Legends|village]] on the planet [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] that had been occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]], and destroyed during a Republic assault.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Jamillia_on_throne.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jamillia, Queen of Naboo]]
Jamillia was a Human female from Naboo. Jamillia was relatively small, measuring only 1.57 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="FF" /> She had a round face with a rather large [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], a narrow chin and pronounced cheeks. Both her [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eye]] [[Color/Legends|color]] were dark brown.<ref name="AOC" /> According to Senator Amidala, Queen Jamillia looked aptly regal, just "every bit the part of Queen". She had a rich,<ref name="AOTCn" /> perfectly regal voice,<ref name="dbJ" /> with a southeastern accent that made her enunciate the consonants powerfully. As she despised small talk, Jamillia would often get to the point of the question very quickly, which made her sound blunt at times.<ref name="AOTCn" />

The Queen preferred to focus on Naboo's internal politics, leaving the conduction of foreign affairs to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="insideII">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jamillia was portrayed by Indian actress [[Ayesha Dharker]] in the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the second installment in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].

Dharker spent a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]], a week-and-a-half in [[Lake Como]] and then a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] in [[Wikipedia:Caserta|Caserta]], [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]] for only half-a-day of shooting.<ref name="SWArchive-The Dharker Side: An Audience with Queen Jamillia">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/profile/f20020903/index.html|text=The Dharker Side: An Audience with Queen Jamillia}}</ref>

In [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary|''Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary'']] and some of the early scripts of ''Attack of the Clones'', the transliteration "Jamilla" was used instead.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=158725&start=75#11220749|thread=Spelling Discrepancies|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2005-06-06|time=9:57 AM}}</ref>
